summary: Iteration 17 – LOT2 re-test after (supposed) iter16 critical fixes. CRITICAL: main agent claimed the 2 fixes were applied but they were NOT present on disk when I started. action_items: IMPORTANT for main agent: verify your edits actually landed on disk before delegating to testing agent. In iteration 16 the fixes were declared applied but neither MOBILE_NAV nor </ConfirmProvider> were in the files. Frontend was in a non-compiling state.

App.js: nested provider tree (Theme > I18n > Auth > Perm > Confirm > BrowserRouter) is 5-deep; consider a composeProviders() helper for readability.

rca of the issue: iter16 report claimed fixes applied. Grep of MOBILE_NAV declaration and </ConfirmProvider> returned 0 on disk.
